consumer.source: GOB 98 gives +1 Contested Withdraw Bonus (stat 1045), in addition to its Viral Defense Bonus and Virologist Upgrade grant. The stock Bonuses display labels 1045 as a percentage.
consumer.runtime: WithdrawalInput applies the signed percentage to the direct stat 1005 input with integer truncation. Existing level and tactic steps apply afterward. Archiving 98 removes its contribution immediately.
consumer.test: [Native PR812](https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/812#issuecomment-7085782452) verified each +1 add and remove, with direct 65 and contest input 68/67/68 while the independent +4 source stayed loaded. OrdinaryWithdrawalInputTests proves signed input and the live roll path.

behavior-tests.source: The passive's two one-point modifiers and loaded grant 1077 are active only with Virologist in memory.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityPassives maintains the bonuses and loaded grant. Typed viral defense uses the defense percentage and ordinary Withdraw reads 1045.
behavior-tests.test: Existing loaded-grant membership and typed-defense tests cover 1077 and the viral defense record. The [stock Withdraw witness](https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/812#issuecomment-7085782452) checks both archive transitions, actual contested rolls and the independent Concealment control.
